findings.summary: Copy-ctor copies o.allocator_'s observer callback and fires observer_.notify() for every transient re-allocation during the COW copy, before restore_statistics; copy-assign keeps its own observer instead — an asymmetry that only surfaces in a COMDARE_CE_ENABLE_OBSERVER_PUSH build.
findings.failure_scenario: Under COMDARE_CE_ENABLE_OBSERVER_PUSH with a callback set on the source allocator, copy-constructing the store would emit spurious per-allocation notifications for the COW copy. Non-live in practice: production is PULL-only (notify() is a null-object) and the push flag is used only by observer-mechanic unit tests that never COW-copy this store, so the two builds never co-occur.

findings.summary: TreeNodePoolStore's copy-ctor/assign call allocator_.restore_statistics() under COMDARE_CE_ENABLE_STATISTICS, but restore_statistics exists ONLY on ExgenAllocator (+ the CRTP base delegate that just forwards to derived().restore_statistics). The class constraint `requires AllocatorStrategy<Alloc>` does NOT require restore_statistics (the concept never mentions it), and the other 28 axis_06 families do not define it. So the store silently depends on a capability broader than its advertised concept — exactly contrary to the Phase-0.3 'Hebel B' intent of swapping the axis_06 strategy.
findings.failure_scenario: In any COMDARE_CE_ENABLE_STATISTICS build, instantiating TreeNodePoolStore<Shape, SomeNonExgenAllocator> (any of the 28 other axis_06 families, e.g. to 'reflect the chosen allocator strategy') and copying it via the COW measure protocol -> hard compile error 'no member restore_statistics' in the copy-ctor/assign. Current code compiles only because both instantiations (TreeNodePoolStore<> / <Shape>) default Alloc=ExgenAllocator. Fix: add restore_statistics to the AllocatorStrategy concept (make it a required capability) or guard the call with `if constexpr (requires { allocator_.restore_statistics(...); })`.

findings.summary: The new live_nodes-from-occupied_count line changes tier_get_allocator's proxy output for the BST-pool composition from live_nodes==0 to live_nodes==occupied_count. Verified NON-negative for other compositions: only TreeNodePoolStore returns rich AllocationStatistics (5 fields) and thus enters this rich branch; all other pool stores return the local {alloc_calls,bytes_allocated,live_nodes} snapshot and hit the unchanged fallback branch. Guard `requires { occupied_count(); }` is const/noexcept-safe (occupied_count is const noexcept on ComposedTreeSearch and both Observable wrappers), and no POD/ABI field is added (only the existing live_nodes field is written; sizeof/standard_layout/trivially_copyable static_asserts remain intact).
findings.failure_scenario: No failure. Documented as the single behavioral delta: a host querying IAllocatorProxyTier on a BstTree/TreeNodePoolStore tier now sees live_nodes==node_count instead of 0. This is more correct and is not consumed by the golden roundtrip (which is codec identity, not value-freeze) nor by the measurement CSV (T6 axis_stats come from fill_observer_v3, whose rich branch already maps the 5 fields, and from assign_allocator_snapshot_ which maps total_bytes_allocated/total_bytes_in_use independently — neither assumes equality, and the test now asserts GE not EQ).

findings.summary: On the OOM-degraded rollback path (cow_materialized_==false), the T6 allocator-stats revert is skipped because it is coupled to the store copy-assign, while only the container T0 POD is restored via restore_statistics(saved_container_algorithm_stats_).
findings.failure_scenario: During a two-phase measured op the warmup insert's cow_materialize_copy_() hits OOM (saved_container_algorithm_.emplace throws, caught, cow_materialized_ stays false). The warmup insert still mutates the live container, so the allocator's stats_ (total_bytes_allocated/allocation_count) increment. tier_rollback_all then skips 'container_algorithm_ = *saved' (which is what would invoke the store operator= -> allocator_.restore_statistics), so the warmup allocation leaks into T6 and the warmup node stays in the live data — measured op then double-counts. This is memory-pressure-only and matches the documented 'Status-quo-aequivalente Mess-Robustheit' noexcept degradation (rollback_is_empirically_exact runs once pre-run, cannot catch mid-run OOM); consistent with the pre-existing organ-stat behavior, not new to Phase 0.3.

findings.summary: In an opt-in push build (COMDARE_CE_ENABLE_OBSERVER_PUSH), the COW copy-ctor fires transient polluted observer notifications during vector construction before restore_statistics sends the clean value; harmless for the shipped pull transport.
findings.failure_scenario: With COMDARE_CE_ENABLE_OBSERVER_PUSH defined, allocator_(o.allocator_) memberwise-copies observer_ (including its std::function callback), then nodes_/free_ construction calls allocate() -> observer_.notify(polluted stats), pushing intermediate polluted snapshots to any subscriber before the final restore_statistics notify. A push-based subscriber that integrates/accumulates every notify (rather than reading final state) would see transient pollution. Non-issue for pull transport (only final statistics() read matters, and notify is a compile-time no-op there); flagged only because push subscribers observe the intermediate copies.

result.reason: The finding is factually accurate that AllocatorStrategy (axis_06_allocator_concept.hpp:75-86) does not require restore_statistics and that the copy-ctor/assign (tree_node_pool_store.hpp:87,99) call it under COMDARE_CE_ENABLE_STATISTICS. However, it does NOT reproduce as a real defect on the actual code: C++ templates only type-check members on instantiation, and a grep over all of libs and tests shows EVERY TreeNodePoolStore<...> instantiation uses the default Alloc=ExgenAllocator (only Shape varies: <>, <Shape>, <BstPtrSizeT>, <BstPtrU32>, <BstPtrU16>). No non-Exgen instantiation exists anywhere, so no compile error is produced — the finding itself concedes the code compiles. Confirmed by belegter Ist-Stand (ctest 202/202 green, stats-OFF compile OK). Furthermore, restore_statistics introduces no new coupling: the store already depends on capabilities outside the concept under the same #ifdef — store_allocator_statistics() calls allocator_.statistics() (line 125) and line 121 uses Alloc::snapshot_t, neither of which is in AllocatorStrategy. A hypothetical non-Exgen allocator would already fail on statistics()/snapshot_t. This is a latent concept-hygiene observation about a not-yet-exercised template path, not a reproducible defect. Per the adversarial 'Im Zweifel REFUTED' standard, REFUTED.

This finding is a [nit] whose own failure scenario is "No failure," and it reproduces as a NON-defect at the real code. Verified: (1) tier_get_allocator is const noexcept (abi_adapter.hpp:268) and occupied_count() is uniformly const noexcept across all organs, so the new line 301-302 is const/noexcept-safe; the `if constexpr (requires{...})` guard makes it robust where absent. (2) The rich 5-field branch (lines 288-303) is entered only by TreeNodePoolStore, which returns Alloc::snapshot_t = 5-field AllocationStatistics (tree_node_pool_store.hpp:125); every other store returns a local 3-field allocator_statistics_snapshot {alloc_calls,bytes_allocated,live_nodes} lacking deallocation_count/failure_count, so they fail the rich requires and hit the unchanged fallback branch (304-315) — scope claim confirmed. (3) No POD/ABI field is added; only the pre-existing out->live_nodes field is written. The rich AllocationStatistics has no live_nodes member, so pre-change the rich branch left live_nodes at zero-init (line 270); the delta is exactly 0 -> occupied_count, which is more correct. (4) No reachable consumer asserts live_nodes==0 in the rich branch; golden roundtrip is codec identity and the CSV fallback path is untouched. No reproducible defect; per "Im Zweifel REFUTED," this is REFUTED.

The described copy-ctor/copy-assign observer asymmetry is not a reproducible defect. TreeNodePoolStore holds its Alloc allocator_ as a private member (line 164) and exposes NO observer()/allocator() accessor — only store_allocator_statistics() (line 125), a by-value PULL snapshot. Since on_event (the sole way to set MeasurableObserver::callback_) is unreachable for this store's internal allocator, callback_ inside allocator_.observer_ is always empty; every observer_.notify(stats_) fired during the COW vector copy is a no-op, and the restore_statistics notify (exgen line 124) is likewise a no-op. Thus the ctor-copies-source-callback vs assign-keeps-own-callback asymmetry produces zero observable difference in ANY build, including a COMDARE_CE_ENABLE_OBSERVER_PUSH build. Notably the finding's own justification ("the two builds never co-occur") is factually wrong — test_v41_topic_traversal compiles TreeNodePoolStore under COMDARE_CE_ENABLE_OBSERVER_PUSH (tests/unit/CMakeLists.txt:356) and calls on_event (test line 174) — but that on_event binds the search algo's own observer, not the pool store's allocator observer, and the test only inserts (no COW copy). The dedicated COW regression test (test_s7_1) is built with STATISTICS but WITHOUT OBSERVER_PUSH (CMakeLists 1690-1691), so notify() is the null object there. No configuration can attach a callback to the store's allocator observer while the store is COW-copied, so the spurious-notification asymmetry cannot manifest. Encapsulation already precludes it. Per the adversarial standard (bereits gehandhabt; im Zweifel REFUTED): REFUTED.

Der behauptete Defekt hat im echten Code keinen reproduzierbaren Pfad. Das Szenario verlangt einen Push-Subscriber am store-internen allocator_.observer_, der die transienten COW-notify()-Aufrufe akkumuliert. TreeNodePoolStore::allocator_ ist jedoch privat (Zeile 164) und wird von KEINEM öffentlichen Accessor herausgereicht; die einzige öffentliche Allocator-Methode store_allocator_statistics() (Zeile 125) liefert nur einen Wert-Snapshot, keinen observer_t&. Es existiert somit keine API, um via on_event() einen Callback am store-internen Allocator-Observer zu registrieren — alle on_event-Testaufrufe (test_v41_topic_traversal.cpp:174, test_v41_topic_allocator_axis_06.cpp, test_v41_topic_queuing.cpp) hängen an eigenständigen Organ-/Allocator-Objekten, nicht am gekapselten allocator_ eines kopierten Stores. In MeasurableObserver::notify (measurable_concept.hpp:69) gilt `if (callback_) callback_(snap)`; da am store-internen Observer nie ein Callback gesetzt werden kann, ist callback_ dort immer leer, sodass jedes transiente notify() während der Vektor-Konstruktion ein No-op-Branch ist, der an niemanden liefert — selbst mit definiertem COMDARE_CE_ENABLE_OBSERVER_PUSH. Der ausgelieferte Transport ist reines PULL (statistics()-Read). Das Finding räumt zudem selbst ein, dass es harmlos für den Pull-Transport ist, und ist als [nit] markiert. Kein reproduzierbarer Defekt.

The code structure is as described (line 1773 restore_statistics only reverts the T0 SearchAlgoStatistics POD via observable_composed_container::restore_statistics -> stats_=s; the T6 allocator-stats revert lives only in TreeNodePoolStore::operator= at line 99 and is reached only through the line 1760 store copy-assign guarded by cow_materialized_). However this is NOT a genuine reproducible defect: (1) it is reachable ONLY under mid-run OOM where the full-container COW copy in cow_materialize_copy_ throws while a single-node insert still succeeds — pure memory pressure; (2) it is the explicitly documented, by-design noexcept degradation ('Status-quo-aequivalente Mess-Robustheit', comment at lines 2185-2186, with the rb_exact probe covering structural cases) — i.e. already handled; (3) when cow_materialized_==false there is no saved copy, so the DATA itself is also not rolled back and the warmup node stays live — the WHOLE period degrades, not a new T6-only asymmetry, so the framing that T6 alone is left dirty while everything else is clean is inaccurate; (4) not a Phase 0.3 regression — the finding itself concedes it is a nit 'consistent with the pre-existing organ-stat behavior, not new to Phase 0.3.' Under the 'already handled / in doubt -> REFUTED' rule, and given ctest is 202/202 green with a proven two-phase COW counter-clean test, this documented OOM-only degradation is not a real defect.
